messages.subject: Aroma + Promoter arrays
parts:
Dear list,
 
I am/we are new in the analysis of the Affymetrix promoter arrays (Human Promoter 1.0R Arrays) AND Aroma (but not on Affy arrays and BioC).
Based on its description Aroma seems to be a good choice for the analysis of many Affy arrays (incl tiling). However, I was wondering whether Aroma could also be used for the analysis of promoter arrays (ChIP-on-chip), since I could not find any info explicity dealing with this on the Google group pages.
If so, do you mind pointing me to a 'getting started'-type of page for such (analogous) analysis? Also, are replicates per biological condition required, even for QC? We do have 6 arrays but only 1 per biological condition. 
 
TIA,
Guido

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: Aroma + Promoter arrays
parts:
Hi,

yes, aroma.affymetrix currently requires that there exists a CDF for
the chip type as well, which I guess is not the case for neither
promotor arrays nor tiling arrays.

It is on the to do list (although not highly prioritized) to make it
possible to at least load a set of CEL files without the CDF so that
you for instance can access the probe intensities and display them
spatially etc. There are also a few preprocessing methods (e.g.
quantile normalization) that in theory should be possible to do
without a CDF. However, don't expect anything soon on this (from me
at least).

Cheers

Henrik
